study type: Risk prediction model development and validation (cross-sectional study)
cohort: The study involved 702 laboring mothers from northwest Amhara comprehensive specialized hospitals.
finding: A risk prediction model for caesarean delivery was developed and internally validated, demonstrating good discrimination (85.1%) and calibration, suggesting its utility in personalizing patient management strategies.
mod_finding: The developed model predicts the risk of caesarean delivery, a specific mode of birth, using various maternal demographic and obstetric variables.
